work.title: Remediate Assurance 001 findings for Redwood R1
authority: Direct user instruction: PROJECT REDWOOD — R1 REMEDIATION BUILD

intent.productGoal: Make the intended Redwood architecture true in runtime behavior without adding unrelated capabilities or inventing professional authority.
intent.capability: Correct gate dependencies, scope/cutoff, claim/cash semantics, executable profile behavior, approval validity, ageing, workbook lineage, and assurance evidence.
architecturalIntent: Build from frozen Build 001 SHA on a dedicated branch.
Keep source evidence, canonical model, method profile, approvals, and output artifacts separately inspectable.
invariants: No forced reconciliation or invented financial values.
No client release if any prerequisite gate is not passed.
Approvals become invalid when their dependency fingerprint changes.
acceptanceEvidence: Focused R1 tests and end-to-end fixture traces.
R1 remediation report and machine-readable conformance record.

decisions.rationale: Preserves Build 001 as historical evidence and prevents remediation contamination.

observedBehaviour: Build 001 gate logic allowed G7 without every prerequisite gate passing and core runtime did not model a first-class deal scope.

evidence.result: Frozen Build 001 source checked out on the remediation branch.

divergences.expected: The full external ENG001 corpus should be used for integration regression.
divergences.observed: The local frozen source contains only ENG001_CONTROL_FIXTURE; the Google Drive corpus is unavailable in this runtime.
